source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
On the test record sheet write down the name and description of the equipment being tested.
3. Perform the test according to manufacturer's directions and record the results. If for some reason you abandon an equipment safety test before it is completed record the reasons using the drop down list.

![Equipment test records with failure drop down list & failure code record field](assets/Equipment_test_records_with_failure_drop_down_list_-_failure_code_record_field.png)

## Examples
The following examples show how to use the drop down list

![Failure drop down list examples](assets/Failure_drop_down_list_examples.png)

1. Visual inspection fails for a piece of equipment (visual inspection failure is selected using drop down list)
2. The 5 amp fuse melts causing a class two equivalent leakage current test to fail (fuse or switch failure is selected using drop down list)
